profile.owner: FieldRoutes, a ServiceTitan company. ServiceTitan bought developer ServicePro.net in Feb 2021 and later folded it into FieldRoutes. FieldRoutes now says ServSuite is sunsetting and is moving customers to FieldRoutes.
profile.target_customers: Pest control, lawn care and arbor companies. Marketed as enterprise software for single or multi-branch operators. Most review-site reviewers are small businesses (2 to 50 employees). FieldRoutes says 40 of the PCT Top 100 use FieldRoutes or ServSuite (combined figure).
profile.pricing: Not published by vendor (quote only; G2 says the vendor has not published pricing). A Basic plan from $55 per user per month, listed on Capterra in earlier research, could not be re-verified in October 2026. One reviewer called it costly. FieldRoutes offers unspecified, cohort-based migration incentives to ServSuite customers who switch.
profile.deployment: Cloud, browser-based web application (multi-browser), with iOS and Android mobile apps. Capterra Canada also lists a Windows on-premise option.
profile.mobile_app: ServSuite Mobile (iPhone and Android phones) and ServSuite Mobile Tablet (iPad and Android tablets), published by Service Pro.net. Still receiving fix releases through October 2026. App Store rating 1.0 from 13 ratings.
integrations: Integrated payment processing (Worldpay per app release notes; a third-party audit cites Global Payments)
QuickBooks (listed on Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice; no vendor doc found)
Cyclr embedded integration connector (read-oriented API methods)
B&G application devices and Brother mobile printers (mobile app)
Voice for Pest (lists ServSuite as an integration partner)
strengths: Long-established pest-specific system: 25+ years of vendor history and over 50,000 users at the 2021 acquisition
Commercial bait station tracking with 1D and 2D barcode scanning and technician-built facility layouts
Broad module set: intelligent routing, GPS fleet tracking, inventory by warehouse and truck, door-to-door sales, e-signature
Integrated card and check payments in the field with stored payment methods for recurring charges
Reviewers praise reporting depth and easy invoicing and work order emailing
weaknesses: Product is being sunset by FieldRoutes with no public end date; FieldRoutes moves customers in incentive-based migration cohorts (at least four), while the ServSuite product page still promises no change
Low review scores: Capterra 2.5/5 (2 reviews), G2 3.1/5 (17 reviews), App Store 1.0/5
Complaints of slow performance, glitches, crashes and slow syncing in the mobile app
Slow support response and resolution, including training requests left pending for months
Dated interface and steep learning curve; routing add-on reported to underperform; pricing not public
profile.wisconsin_notes: Kwik Kill Pest Control of Madison ran ServSuite from 2013 until it moved to FieldRoutes in 2023 (FieldRoutes case study). No current Wisconsin ServSuite user found: a 2026-10-29 scan of 38 Wisconsin independents' websites found no ServSuite portal. No ATCP 29 record support, landscape registry notice or other Wisconsin-specific compliance found in public sources.
